correctness.rationale: The proof independently establishes simple connectivity of the wheel matching complex via its rim Ind(C_10) and ten spoke cones on Ind(P_8); both path and cycle independence complexes are simply connected. Two reflections fixing matching vertices generate D_10, so Armstrong gives pi_1 of the ordinary quotient equal to one. A full chain-orbit enumeration after barycentric subdivision, integer boundary-squared checks, independent Burnside counts, and exact Smith normal forms yield quotient cell ranks (43,343,882,894,312), boundary ranks (42,301,581,312), all nonzero Smith factors equal to one, and H_0=H_3=Z with all other integral homology zero. The code in code/verify_wheel_quotient.py was executed from the current package path and matches verification/output.txt; this is exhaustive for the fixed graph. Hurewicz plus homological Whitehead then gives the homotopy equivalence to S^3. Remaining limitations: reliance on exact Smith implementation and standard topological theorems; independent audit not performed.

value.rationale: The ten-rim wheel is the earliest wheel in the known rational periodicity whose full dihedral matching quotient supports a rational class in degree greater than one. Precisely there, knowledge of rational Betti numbers leaves substantive integral torsion and higher-homotopy ambiguity. The new answer is an exact homotopy equivalence to S^3 with a checkable integer boundary certificate and a structural fundamental-group proof. This natural complete classification is valuable without requiring an all-wheel theorem; the claim is not a routine restatement of the rational result.
